1033. Queue using Linked List

Problem Statement:
Creation of Linked List implementation of Queue ADT.
input_spec:
Creation of Linked List implementation of Queue ADT.

The first line of the input N is an integer denoting the number of elements in the queue Q.

The second line of the input consists of the N space-separated queue element from start to .

The third line of the input is the integer O denoting the operation that needs to be performed and additional new value X in case of the enqueue operation.

The operations are as follows:

1- Enqueue

2- Dequeue
output_spec: Print the queue from start to end in a space-separated format after performing the selected operation.
